_comment: The element `actions` @qontinui/ui-bridge 0.46.0 (ui-bridge 9f373a12, core/element-kind.ts inferActions) serves for runner elements, in the SDK's canonical order. The frontend tests MEASURE them against the real SDK (src/lib/ui-bridge/autoRegisterVerbs.dom.test.tsx, src/components/terminal/sessionAddressability.test.ts); the Rust tests read this same file with include_str! (mcp/ui_bridge/elements.rs, mcp/ui_bridge/action_vocabulary.rs), so a change to a served list fails on both sides.
